translated_title: In Mexico, Collectives Will March This Sunday in Defense of Cuba and Anti-Imperialism
original_title: Colectivos marcharán este domingo en defensa de Cuba y el antimperialismo
author: Iván Evair Saldaña and Jessica Xantomila
meta_description: Organizers expect a bigger turnout than the annual July 26 mobilizations, marching to the former U.S. embassy on the 73rd Moncada anniversary.
